title: Setting Property Credit Drawn Down against a Hotel Rate Plans Departure Balance
content:
Whether the property credit a guest drew down lowers the balance settled at departure on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on whether any was drawn down and on whether the rate plan booked carries a property credit amount at all.

## The rule

1. Where property credit has been drawn down on the reservation and the rate plan booked carries a property credit amount, 100 percent of the credit drawn down is set against the balance.
2. Where property credit has been drawn down on the reservation and the rate plan booked carries no property credit amount, 0 percent of it is set against the balance.
3. Where no property credit has been drawn down, 0 percent is set against the balance.

## The property credit amount each plan carries

| Rate plan | Property credit per stay, USD | Carries a property credit amount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0.0 | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0.0 | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 0.0 | no |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 25.0 | yes |
| Member Flex Rate | 50.0 | yes |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 100.0 | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 200.0 | yes |

## The combinations

| Property credit drawn down | Plan carries a property credit amount | Share set against the balance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 100 percent |
| yes | no | 0 percent |
| no | yes | 0 percent |
| no | no | 0 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Property credit drawn down of 40.00 USD on the reservation:

- On the Suite Flexible Rate, which carries 100.0 USD of property credit, 100 percent is set against the balance, lowering it by 40.00 USD.
- On the Semi-Flexible Rate, which carries none, 0 percent is set against the balance, lowering it by 0.00 USD.
- Where no credit had been drawn down, nothing would be set against the balance on either plan.
